QUOTE: `library/error.c` is the output of `scripts/generate_errors.pl`, run by a CMake custom command in `library/CMakeLists.txt:134`. That command takes `include/mbedtls` and `scripts/data_files`, and depends on the error headers and `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated by generate_errors.pl from the public headers, and that the command depends on error.fmt. The "template" role of error.fmt is only implied.
